purpose: Implement the ADR-4147 decision: `rcf verify run` gains a repeatable `--fbs <id>` filter resolved in the chain reader to the acceptance criteria bound to the named FBS items; the engine feeds the scoped set to per-AC verdicts, provisioning, the adversarial brief, the deterministic ledger and the EVAL coverage rollup, and stamps `run.scope` and `run.scopeAcCount` on every report path. `rcf build finalise <fbs-id>` passes its FBS as the filter by default, exposes `--all` to pass no filter, refuses an FBS with zero bound criteria before launching verify, and names the scope in its launch and refusal lines. The MCP verify tool accepts `fbsIds`.
responsibilities: src/verify/chain/index.js readChain additionally returns fbsItems as { fbsId, acIds } so scope resolution never re-opens the tree.

src/verify/chain/scope.js resolveScope({ chain, fbsIds }) returns the scoped ACs plus a scope label ('chain' or 'fbs:<ids>') and the AC count; an unknown FBS id is a usage error naming the id; an FBS with no bound criteria is a usage error with a plain message.

src/verify/engine/index.js takes opts.fbsIds, resolves the scope after reading the chain, and uses the scoped ACs for perAcVerdicts, provisioning, composeBrief, runDeterministic and evalCoverage; buildReport receives scope and scopeAcCount on the normal, NOT-DEPLOYED and LAUNCH-FAILURE paths.
src/verify/report/index.js carries run.scope and run.scopeAcCount; src/verify/report/renderer.js prints the scope line under Runtime provenance.
src/verify/cli/run.js adds --fbs <id> (repeatable, comma lists accepted), passes fbsIds to the engine, prints a Verify scope line on stderr and documents the option in HELP.
src/verify/mcp/tools.js adds fbsIds (array of strings) to the rcf_verify_run input schema and passes it through.
src/finalise/spawn.js buildVerifyArgs appends --fbs <id> for each entry in opts.fbsIds.

src/cli/finalise.js adds --all, names an FBS with no bound criteria plainly on the walker-error path (the schema refuses an empty acIds list; exit 3) before launch, passes fbsIds [fbsId] unless --all, refuses promotion whenever the report's blockedAcs list is non-empty (every entry is in scope) in any mode, and names the scope in the launch line, the refusal lines and HELP.
internalStructure: Scope resolution is a pure function over the chain read-out; the engine calls it once and threads the scoped array everywhere chain.acs was used. Finalise's change is a flag, a precondition and a one-field thread-through to buildVerifyArgs. Nothing under the chain reader imports the write path.
notes: Behavioural change on the finalise default (per FBS instead of whole chain); `rcf verify run` without --fbs is unchanged. No rcf-schemas bump: the report's run object accepts additional fields.
name: finalise per-FBS verify scope: --fbs filter on verify run, --all escape on finalise
